name: s5-departed-caller
description: S5. A departed caller rings from 555-0193, one of the numbers lambdas/README.md reserves for the dead. caller-lookup does not know them, they say nobody is hurt (the safety question is never skipped), plane-check answers beyond, and hh-hotline-main transfers to hh-dead-line: the welcome, agent-only recording, the four hooks, the routing adjustment, the callback number (either CallbackNumberNotDialable or InvalidCallbackNumber may fire for a simulated source, VERIFY.md 6.2; both rejoin, so the scenario accepts either), the check of hours:the-dead (both branches continue) and the transfer to queue:the-dead. No substitution: the dead's hours are always open. The test ends at the queue transfer.
